title: Counters, gauges, percentiles
prompt:
1. `static long p(List<Long> sortedMicros, double q)` — the q-th percentile of a
SORTED list: index = ceil(q * n) - 1, clamped to >= 0. p(x, 0.5) is the median.
2. `static java.util.Map<String, Long> summarize(java.util.List<Long> durations)` —
sort internally, return {"p50":..., "p95":..., "p99":..., "count": n}.
3. `static boolean avgHides(List<Long> durations)` — return true iff the MEAN is
less than p95 (the classic 'average looks fine' lie). Empty list → false.
4. `static boolean cardinalityOk(String labelKey)` — true iff labelKey is a CLASS
(one of "endpoint", "status", "region"), false for instance labels
("userId", "requestId", "url").

tests.name: percentile math and the average lie
tests.hint: Averages hide tails; percentiles expose them.
